subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this grouped action refresh land after direct Codex contract verification and clean current-head workflow checks, or should credential-bearing action updates be split for narrower review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but it replaces executable dependencies across several secret-bearing and security-scanning workflows, and repository policy reserves the protected security decision for a human owner.

options.title: Verify and land together
options.body: Complete the Codex contract check, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update once security-sensitive workflow gates pass on the exact head.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token, registry, and CodeQL action upgrades from routine setup and maintenance actions for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Regenerate later
options.body: Close or pause this branch until Dependabot repository access is stable, then regenerate the grouped update against current `main`.

recommendation.title: Verify and land together
recommendation.body: Complete the Codex contract check, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update once security-sensitive workflow gates pass on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available recent workflow/release history signal and the repository's documented final decision-maker.
